questions: Are you experiencing any pain in your right hand or wrist?
Do you have a history of arthritis?
Have you had any recent injuries to your right arm or hand?
Does the shaking happen when you are trying to do something, like holding a cup?
Does the shaking happen when your hand is completely resting on your lap?
Is anyone else in your family known to have hand tremors?
